jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Research- EN
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Strategy & Development
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year
, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Trulioo is seeking a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy & Development to help shape the company’s strategic direction and translate it into coordinated action across the business. Working closely with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer, this leader will own the continued evolution of Trulioo’s strategic blueprint, strengthen alignment between corporate strategy and functional priorities, and guide execution of the company’s most important strategic initiatives.

This role will build the intelligence, governance, and execution capabilities that allow Trulioo to anticipate market change and make informed choices about where and how to compete. The Senior Director will bring together customer, competitive, regulatory, economic, industry, and product insights to test strategic assumptions, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and inform decisions across organic investment, partnerships, and acquisitions.

This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role at the intersection of strategy, product, transformation, capital allocation, and corporate development. The ideal candidate combines forward-looking strategic judgment with the ability to operationalize ideas—building roadmaps, mobilizing accountable leaders, guiding complex programs, and creating the governance needed to turn strategy into measurable results.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, working remotely.

What You'll Be Doing

Corporate Strategy and Strategic Blueprint Support

Continuously test the strategy against market forces, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, customer needs, technology shifts, and emerging opportunity areas.
Partner with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer to prepare strategic recommendations and decision materials for executives, the Board, external advisors, and other key stakeholders.
Design scenario analyses that evaluate strategic assumptions, alternative market outcomes, competitive responses, investment choices, and potential disruptions.
Identify material risks to the strategy and partner with the Enterprise Risk Office to assess exposure, define responses, and integrate strategic risks into enterprise governance.
Develop clear points of view on competitive positioning, market adjacencies, thematic investments, and the capabilities Trulioo will need to win over the long term.
Co-lead recurring strategy reviews and recommend when elements of the strategic blueprint should be accelerated, refined, reprioritized, or recast.

Strategy Alignment and Execution

Translate the strategic blueprint into enterprise priorities, functional goals, measurable outcomes, and clear execution roadmaps.
Partner with executive and functional leaders to align their strategies, investments, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and/or incentives with the company’s strategic direction.
Define the scope, activities, sequencing, investment requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, and measures of success for major strategic programs.
Establish and chair governance forums that track progress against strategic priorities and create clear paths for decision-making and escalation.
Partner with the Transformation Office and accountable workstream leaders to mobilize initiatives, resolve cross-functional blockers, measure progress and performance, and redirect execution when outcomes move off course.
Create recurring feedback loops, including shared metrics reviews and strategy check-ins, to identify misalignment early and improve execution.
Communicate the strategy across the organization in ways that build understanding of Trulioo’s direction, strategic choices, and highest-priority activities.

MAPS and Capital Allocation Governance

Lead MAPS—Trulioo’s quarterly Market Aligned Product Strategy program—to connect corporate strategy and market intelligence with product strategy, investment decisions, and roadmaps.
Bring together Product, Engineering, Strategy, Risk and Reg, Sales, Marketing, and GTM leaders to evaluate emerging customer needs and market opportunities.
Guide structured decisions on whether Trulioo should build, buy, partner, watch, or pass in response to identified opportunities.
Oversee the development of MAPS insight packages covering regulatory change, voice of the customer, competitive moves, market potential, cost of missed opportunity, industry trends, and product performance.
In coordination with the Office of the CFO, develop and operate a disciplined capital allocation governance program that connects strategic priorities with investment decisions.
Build decision frameworks that clarify opportunity, strategic fit, expected value, investment requirements, trade-offs, risks, and measures of success.
Produce a forward-looking point of view on capital allocation priorities informed by Trulioo’s competitive position, portfolio performance, and emerging growth opportunities.

Corporate Development and M&A

Support the development of Trulioo’s Build, Buy, and Partner strategy by identifying capability gaps and evaluating inorganic paths to accelerate the strategic blueprint.
Support market mapping, opportunity screening, target identification, strategic fit assessments, and ongoing target monitoring.
Coordinate cross-functional due diligence, including workstream planning, information synthesis, issue escalation, decision support, and executive reporting.
Contribute to due diligence activities and deal-structure considerations in partnership with Finance, Legal, Product, Technology, Risk, and external advisors.
Develop scalable models, AI agents, and analytical tools that strengthen opportunity screening, target intelligence, diligence, and transaction decision-making.
Capture relevant integration considerations during diligence and translate findings into clear implications for value creation, execution complexity, and transaction risk.

Market Insights and Strategic Intelligence

Design and operate Trulioo’s enterprise market insights program as a continuously running intelligence engine for strategy, product development, investment, and commercialization.
Produce forward-looking insights, including market landscapes, competitive positioning, opportunity sizing, thematic investment perspectives, regulatory outlooks, and voice-of-the-customer analysis.
Build repeatable methods for gathering, validating, synthesizing, and distributing intelligence across the organization.
Translate complex signals into clear strategic implications, executive-level reporting, and actionable recommendations.
Deliver relevant insights to executives, Product, Engineering, Risk and Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and GTM teams through recurring briefings, dashboards, decision forums, and targeted analyses.
Develop measures that demonstrate how market intelligence improves strategic decisions, product prioritization, capital allocation, and commercial outcomes.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience across corporate strategy, corporate development, strategic finance, management consulting, market intelligence, transformation, or related leadership roles.
Significant experience in one or more relevant sectors, including payments, financial services, banking, marketplaces, SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, or RegTech.
A degree in economics, business, finance, strategy, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
A builder mindset and strong experience working and deploying AI tools and models to improve functional processes, drive automation, rethink problem solving, and transform traditional ways of working.
Demonstrated experience developing corporate or product strategies and translating them into enterprise priorities, functional roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Experience operating in complex, global, and highly cross-functional organizations.
Experience leading large-scale strategic or transformation programs involving multiple executives, functions, and dependencies.
Meaningful experience supporting acquisitions, including opportunity assessment, target screening, due diligence, transaction analysis, and integration planning.
Advanced analytical and scenario-planning capabilities, with the ability to work through ambiguity and make clear recommendations from incomplete or conflicting information.
Exceptional executive communication skills and experience preparing materials for executive leadership, Boards, and external advisors.
The judgment and executive presence to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, facilitate difficult trade-offs, and drive decisions.

Nice To Have

Exposure to identity verification, fraud prevention, credit insights, financial crime, or regulatory technology.
Experience supporting IPO readiness, public-company strategy, or Board-level capital allocation processes.
Direct experience leading post-acquisition integration or value-creation programs.
An advanced degree in economics, business, finance, or a related discipline.

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we

jobs.title: Finance Director (6 month contract)
jobs.description:
This is a 6 month contract with permanent potential at the end of the contract

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.
Assist in preparing for audits, including providing necessary documentation for revenue and payroll audits.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding payroll and revenue recognition.

Process Improvement:
Continuously assess and improve payroll and revenue recognition processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline payroll processing and financial reporting.
Collaborate with IT and software vendors to maintain and optimize payroll and accounting systems.

Skills
Exceptional attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.).

About You

CPA or other relevant certifications preferred.
5+ years of experience in accounting or finance, with a focus on IFRS reporting.
Strong knowledge of IFRS
and experience preparing and reviewing complex financial statements and disclosures.
Experience leading external audits and working effectively with external auditors and other key stakeholders.
Proven experience managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial reporting processes
.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 or equivalent).
Solid understanding of accounting principles and regulatory requirements
